My `addr()` test helper requires j == len(v), which is wrong for cases with trailing junk — the address parser legitimately stops before the junk and the caller rejects. So those "failures" are expected behavior:

- `'sip:alice@lab.test>'` → the bare URI scan stops at `>` giving a valid URI and j=18; caller sees `>` → rejects ✓.
- etc. All fine.
